entries.prompt: Take the provided portrait image as the ONLY reference for Caralyn Chwedonol. Create one square 1:1 complete 3×3 expression and gesture sheet, 9 equally sized panels, no gutters. EXACT same young adult red-haired green-eyed female knight, identical face, hairstyle, age, green/gold mermaid tabard and brown armor, same anime line art and cel shading, same warm stone castle background and lighting in ALL panels. Chest to upper body with hands visible, identical camera distance. Do NOT redesign. Every emotion needs its own clear natural hand gesture and body posture. No text, captions, numbers, speech bubbles, symbols, props, borders or white separator lines. Hands empty and free to gesture. Theme: Alltag und Gespräch. Panels in reading order: 1 explaining with both palms open; 2 friendly greeting with one hand lifted; 3 thoughtful hand on chin; 4 skeptical crossed arms and one raised eyebrow; 5 surprised hands raised; 6 annoyed waving away; 7 determined fist at chest; 8 confrontational firm hand chop; 9 uncertain shrug with both palms up. Preserve facial identity, hair volume, clothing, colors, proportions, background, palette and lighting exactly. Readable expressive hand acting, believable anatomy, no neutral filler. Entire square contains ONLY the nine portrait tiles.
